summary: Describes Adobe's Secure Real-Time Media Flow Protocol (RTMFP), a protocol for securely carrying several parallel flows of real-time video, audio, data and bulk transfers between two endpoints. It is designed to work for peer-to-peer as well as client-server use, including through NAT devices. This is an informational description of a vendor protocol.

eli5.summary: It is a way for two computers to send video, voice and files side by side, safely, even when home routers get in the way.
